description: Return the full historic time series — either two-qubit gate error rates ("fidelity") or physical qubit counts ("qubit-count") — broken down by hardware type. Each datapoint carries a source URL. Use this to extrapolate trends — "when might hardware reach X?" — or pair with fit_historic_series for a log-linear fit on one hardware type.

seriesType.description: "fidelity" → 2-qubit gate error rates; "qubit-count" → physical qubit counts.

name: get_historic_series
title: Historic Hardware Series (Fidelity or Qubit Count)
